equity_bridge.item: Pension and OPEB deficit, after tax
equity_bridge.note: 10-K FY2025: plans underfunded by ~$471M at 31 Dec 2025; x (1-21%) = 372 debt-like deduction

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2026 guidance organic 3-4% (raised at Q3-2026) net of ~1pt Kidney Care MSA run-off; cross-checked against the FY2022-FY2025 continuing-ops revenue CAGR of 3.8% (10,057 -> 11,244), of which ~1pt is MSA sales in FY2025
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-7.6% 5yr, +1.3% 3yr) diverges from revenue because of $1.4B of goodwill/intangible impairments in FY2024-FY2025 and the Kidney Care sale; EPS CAGRs are undefined (losses in FY2022, FY2024, FY2025). Neither is a usable growth anchor; revenue and guidance are.
historical_growth.notes: Only FY2022-FY2025 are on the continuing-ops (ex-Kidney Care) basis; FY2021 and earlier include ~$4.7B of Kidney Care revenue and are excluded from every CAGR. Owner FCF on the continuing basis: FY2023 660 (OCF 1,207 - capex 432 - SBC 115), FY2024 259 (819 - 446 - 114), FY2025 321 (951 - 513 - 117), TTM Sep-2026 1,051 (flattered by ~$500M working-capital release). The series is dominated by Hurricane Helene costs, the 2025 inventory build and its unwind, and separation costs, so no FCF CAGR is reported; the forward build is anchored on components, not on this history. SBC is ~1% of revenue and stable, so SBC is not a growing share of reported cash flow.

scenario_narratives.base: Guidance-level organic growth (3-4%) fading to 2.5% as the Kidney Care MSA runs off; adjusted operating margin recovers ~180bp to ~15.5% by year 5 from separation-cost roll-off and the cost programme while ~1pt of revenue stays in recurring restructuring; cash tax ramps 18% -> 22%; capex converges on depreciation at ~4% of revenue; terminal 15x owner FCF (cap binds).
scenario_narratives.bull: Novum LVP returns in 2027, Round Lake remediated, hospital capex cycle turns up, Advanced Surgery and CCS backlog drive 4.5-5% growth; margin returns to Baxter's pre-Hillrom ~17% adjusted; leverage falls below 3x and the outlook returns to Stable; terminal 17x.
scenario_narratives.bear: Round Lake escalates, Novum never returns, hospital capex downturn triggers further HST impairments; growth 1-2%, margin stuck near 13% adjusted, IRS settlement above reserve, downgrade to high-yield; terminal 13x. The equity is a thin slice under $8.6B of debt, so value falls disproportionately.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Baxter post-Vantive is a ~$11.6B revenue, low-growth hospital-supplies and connected-care business whose equity value is highly geared to small changes in margin and multiple because ~$6.6B of net debt (plus a $0.4B pension deficit) sits ahead of it. The valuation therefore anchors on an unlevered owner-FCF build from company-defined adjusted operating income, haircut for the cash restructuring Baxter books as 'special' every year, with the FY2025 impairments and tax charge treated as non-cash/one-off and the ~3pts of transitional Vantive supply sales treated as run-off rather than growth. The terminal multiple is capped at 15x owner FCF; at a 7.5% WACC Gordon would imply 20x, which a quality-challenged, leveraged slow-grower is not granted. House basis expenses SBC (~1% of revenue, so the house/street band is narrow) and holds the share count flat.
key_risks_to_valuation: Leverage: each 1pt of EBITDA margin is worth roughly $5/share of equity value; the bear-case equity is less than half the base because debt is senior to it
FDA enforcement: Round Lake Warning Letter (Sep 2026) and Novum LVP Class I recall/shipment hold; a consent decree or further hold would cut injectables and pump revenue directly

Hospital capital-spending cycle for beds, monitors and pumps (HST segment ~27% of revenue), which also drives the risk of further Front Line Care goodwill ($1.5B) and Welch Allyn trade-name ($390M) impairments
Kidney Care MSA run-off (~$360M TTM) and TSA income (~$180M/yr in other operating income) roll off over the next several years
IRS transfer-pricing examination (2019-2020 settled Q2-2026; 2021-2025 open, $280M reserved) and US valuation allowance: cash tax could step up faster than the modelled ramp
Working-capital reversal: TTM reported FCF of $1.16B embeds ~$0.5B of inventory unwind that will not recur; anyone valuing Baxter off reported TTM FCF is capitalising a one-off
Credit ratings: Negative outlook at S&P and Moody's since Q1-2026; a downgrade to high yield raises refinancing cost on $8.6B of debt maturing 2028-2051

inputs.base_revenue_note: TTM to 30 Sep 2026, continuing operations: FY2025 11,244 + 9M-2026 8,637 - 9M-2025 8,270. Kidney Care (Vantive) is in discontinued ops throughout; the base still carries ~$360M of Kidney Care MSA supply sales to Vantive ('Other' segment, running off ~1pt/yr of reported growth).
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted, Q3-2026 10-Q EPS note: 517M basic + 3M dilutive RSU/PSU/option effect = 520M (683.49M issued less 166.15M treasury = 517.3M outstanding at 30 Sep 2026). Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows; no buyback programme and no non-SBC issuance.
inputs.net_debt_note: Q3-2026 balance sheet (30 Sep 2026): current maturities of LTD and finance leases 844 + long-term debt and finance leases 7,757 + short-term debt 0 = 8,601 (10-Q: 'approximately $8.60 billion of long-term debt and finance lease obligations, including current maturities and short-term debt'). Cash and equivalents 1,975. Finance leases are inside total debt; operating leases are expensed inside EBITDA (one lease treatment).
inputs.reported_fcf_note: TTM continuing-ops OCF 1,664 (FY2025 951 + 9M-2026 1,068 - 9M-2025 355) less TTM capex 503 (513 + 363 - 373). Flattered by ~$500M of working-capital release (Q4-2025 inventory unwind after the 2025 build); the underlying TTM levered owner FCF is nearer $550M and the unlevered equivalent ~$800M, which is what the year-1 component build is anchored against.
inputs.interest_income_note: TTM interest income ~$50M (FY2025 52) is NOT stripped: Baxter is a net debtor (net debt 6.6x the FCF base), so no cash pile is being double-counted.
inputs.sbc_source: 10-K FY2025 cash flow statement 'Stock compensation' $117M; 10-Q Q3-2026 9M $73M vs 9M-2025 $80M -> TTM $110M. Baxter publishes no combined SBC-plus-equity-award-tax figure; net-share-settlement taxes sit undisclosed inside 'Other financing activities, net' (-$57M FY2025 incl. other items) and are not added.
inputs.buyback_note: No repurchases FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 or 9M-2026 (cash flow statement). Flat count is a modelling convention the company is not currently funding; dilution is ~0.6%/yr gross, offset in the model by the SBC charge.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows. Rf 4.2% (10y UST), ERP 5.0%, levered beta ~1.1 (0.9 med-tech asset beta re-levered for ~39% debt weight) -> cost of equity ~9.7%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~4.7% (Q4-2025 notes 4.45-5.65%, blended book coupon ~3.5%, BBB-/Baa3-area with Negative outlook at S&P and Moody's since Q1-2026) -> ~3.7% after tax. Weights at market: equity 13.4B / debt 8.6B. WACC 7.5%, held identical across scenarios; leverage, quality and turnaround risk are charged through the scenario paths and the 25% bear weight, not through a stacked WACC premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Finance leases ($38M FY2025) are inside total debt. Operating lease cost is expensed inside EBITDA (segment results include rent) and the ROU liability is NOT added to net debt, so leases are charged exactly once.
inputs.nci_treatment: Noncontrolling interests are -$27M (a deficit) with zero attributable income; ignored.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company route, SKILL.md row 2 - US multinational med-tech with cyclical hospital-capex exposure). First valuation of this ticker. BASE PERIOD: TTM to 30 Sep 2026 on the continuing-ops basis (Kidney Care in discontinued ops) so revenue, flows and the 30 Sep 2026 net debt describe the same twelve months; FY2021-and-earlier figures include ~$4.7B of Kidney Care revenue and are not like-for-like. MARGIN ANCHOR: the engine's EBITDA is pre-SBC. Company-defined adjusted operating income (ex intangible amortisation and special items) was 1,590 in FY2025 (14.1%) and ~1,500 TTM (12.9%); FY2026 adjusted EPS guidance of $2.05-2.15 implies ~1,600 (~13.7%). Add depreciation ex acquired-intangible amortisation (~3.3%: FY2025 D&A 981 less amortisation 598 = 383) and SBC (~1.0%) and subtract ~1.8pts for the cash 'special items' that recur every year at Baxter (business optimisation ~$180M/yr for a decade, now plus 'business transformation' $54M 9M-2026 and separation costs tailing off) -> year-1 engine EBITDA margin 16.0%. D&A path is depreciation only: the ~$590M/yr acquired-intangible amortisation is non-cash, is not replaced by capex, and the tax deductibility it carries is reflected in the sub-statutory cash tax ramp (FY2025 cash taxes paid 223; US valuation allowance means US income is sheltered near-term). REVENUE: FY2025 headline +5.7% carried ~3pts of Kidney Care MSA sales (381 vs 67); underlying ~3%. FY2026 guidance organic 3-4% raised at Q3; MSA run-off costs ~1pt of reported growth, FX roughly neutral forward -> base year-1 3.5%. WORKING CAPITAL: manufacturer with inventory+receivables well above payables (~26% of revenue net), so wc_capture is NEGATIVE (-15% of the revenue increase). TERMINAL: cap 15x owner FCF binds in base (Gordon at 7.5%/2.5% would be 20.5x); a slow-growing, leveraged, quality-challenged med-tech does not command a 20x exit. EQUITY BRIDGE: pension/OPEB deficit $471M at FY2025 taken as debt-like after 21% tax. The $280M IRS transfer-pricing reserve (2019-2025 open) is an accrued liability, not in net debt; it is treated as a cash-tax risk in the bear path rather than a bridge item.

bear.narrative: Quality problems compound: the Round Lake Warning Letter escalates to a consent decree or supply interruption in sterile injectables, the Novum LVP never returns and Spectrum IQ loses pump placements to BD Alaris, and a hospital capex downturn hits beds and monitors so the Front Line Care goodwill ($1.5B) and Welch Allyn trade name ($390M) are impaired again. Revenue grows 1-2% (MSA run-off plus share loss), the margin stays stuck near 13% adjusted as remediation and tariff costs absorb the cost programme, the IRS transfer-pricing exam (2021-2025 open, $280M reserved) settles above reserve and lifts cash tax to 23%, and with ~$8.6B of debt the agencies downgrade to BB+, raising refinancing cost. Equity value is thin because the debt is senior to it. Terminal cap 13x.

base.narrative: Guidance delivered and then a slow grind: organic 3-4% in FY2026 fades to 2.5% as the Kidney Care MSA runs off and the Novum LVP hold persists through 2027; Advanced Surgery (+12%) and CCS backlog carry the growth. Adjusted operating margin recovers from ~13.7% to ~15.5% by year 5 as separation costs end and the Baxter Growth and Performance System takes ~150bp of cost out, while ~1pt of revenue continues to go on restructuring every year. Cash tax ramps from 18% (US valuation-allowance shelter, intangible deductions) to 22%. Capex trends from 4.3% to 4.0% of revenue, converging on depreciation.

bull.narrative: The Hider turnaround works: Novum LVP returns to the US market in 2027 and recaptures pump share from BD/ICU, Round Lake is remediated without supply loss, hospital capital budgets loosen as rates fall and the CCS bed/monitoring backlog converts, and Advanced Surgery keeps compounding at low double digits. Adjusted operating margin returns to the ~17% Baxter earned before Hillrom's problems and Helene, restructuring charges genuinely fade, and the balance sheet de-levers below 3x so the ratings outlook returns to Stable. Terminal cap 17x reflects a re-rated, steadily growing med-tech.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because the equity sits beneath $8.6B of debt with both agencies on Negative outlook, the company has an active FDA Warning Letter at its sterile-injectables plant and a Class I pump recall with an open-ended shipment hold, and the thesis rests on a new CEO/CFO turnaround that is one year old. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because the bull case needs several independent things to go right (Novum re-launch, Round Lake clearance, a hospital capex upturn and sustained cost delivery). Base 50%: the Q3-2026 beat and raised guidance show the core consumables franchise is performing to plan.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
